system.name: EmbodiedGPT
system.one_liner: An end-to-end multi-modal embodied foundation model trained with embodied chain-of-thought (EgoCOT) for planning, captioning, VQA and low-level control.

content.variant_note: a two-turn chat transcript with a real robot video and real answers, with a small result chart tucked beside it; the caption lists the capabilities shown
content.argues: EmbodiedGPT can describe a robot video, hold a multi-turn dialogue, give an executable step plan, and its task-specific features raise embodied control success over R3M and BLIP-2.
content.subject: A two-turn dialogue about a robot-arm video (description, then a five-step plan) beside a bar chart of control success rates.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a model's capabilities as a short real conversation: tint bubbles by speaker, draw the input video as a framed strip inside the user's bubble, tint the key phrases of the answers, and tuck one small result chart beside the dialogue.
lessons.suits: foundation models or agents whose value is shown by what they say about a real input (video, image) and by one headline benchmark number.

evidence: EmbodiedGPT’s capabilities for video captioning, multi-turn question answering, embodied planning, and low-level control.
The plans given by EmbodiedGPT are highly executable and incorporate task-specific features

summary: EmbodiedGPT is an end-to-end multi-modal foundation model for embodied AI, trained on the EgoCOT dataset of Ego4D videos with chain-of-thought sub-goal plans. Figure 1 is a showcase of its capabilities drawn as a chat transcript. Orange human bubbles and blue assistant bubbles, each with a cartoon avatar, run top to bottom: the user asks for a detailed description of a six-frame robot-arm video and gets a long scene description; then asks for a plan and gets the task name with Steps 1 to 5. Key phrases are tinted blue. A small grouped bar chart at the lower right, Embodied Control Performance, shows success rates on Franka Kitchen and Metaworld for BLIP-2[Ego4D], R3M and EmbodiedGPT, the last highest.
summary_zh: EmbodiedGPT 是用 EgoCOT 思维链数据训练的端到端具身多模态模型。图以对话展示能力：橙色用户、蓝色助手气泡自上而下，先描述六帧机械臂视频，再给五步开门计划，关键短语标蓝；右下角柱状图比较控制成功率。
notes: The prior attribute panels=2 treated the chart as a second panel; here it is an inset chart (listed under pictures) in one chat-column drawing. The chart is a bitmap and its legend hides the top of one bar, so that value is not readable. Chart bar colours are read off the bitmap and approximate.
